lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: In this world, there's a town where once a year, one family gets to bring a loved one back from the dead.

lines.speaker: huss
lines.text: Huss... huss... huss...

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: And this year, it was finally my family's turn.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Funny thing is, I can't remember when Mum and Dad died. That part's all fuzzy.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: But my little brother, Leo? I remember it like it was yesterday.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: We did everything together. Especially skating.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Kickflips. Grinds. Even the risky stuff Mum banned us from doing.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Then one day, Leo was skating on the road, and a truck swerved.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: I ran faster than I've ever run in my life.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: But I was too late.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: I haven't been the same since.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: So I made up my mind. The wish was his. I was bringing Leo back.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Mum and Dad would understand. They're probably on some trip anyway.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: So I waited. Days went by.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Then, the night before the wish, I saw Icey.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Icey was our dog. He died a year ago.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: But there he was. Same floppy ear. Same crooked tail.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: And he would not. Stop. Barking.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: He kept dragging me toward the cemetery.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: No, Icey. I'm not going to look at Leo's grave. He's coming back tomorrow.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: But the barking got louder. And louder.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: So I followed him.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: We reached the grave, and before I could even read it, I broke down crying.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Then I looked up. And the name on the stone, was mine.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: And it all came back.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: I wasn't too late. I pushed Leo out of the way. The truck hit me.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Mum and Dad never died. That's why I couldn't remember it.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: This isn't the town that brings people back. It's the town they bring people back from.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: A ghost town.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: But that was okay. Tomorrow was my family's turn. Surely, they'd pick me.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: So the day came. I waited by the gate.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Morning. Noon. Midnight.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: I was still here.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: And Icey, was gone.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: They didn't pick me.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: They picked the dog.
